Out-of-core backward smoothing

Source: R/func_bigdata.R
BS_bigdata_R.Rd

Runs the backward smoothing pass over the filtered moments that FF_bigdata_R() wrote to disk, one time step at a time, and writes the smoothed moments to CSV files. The result equals BS() applied to the in-memory filter over the same blocks, without holding all episodes in memory.

Usage

BS_bigdata_R(
  ff_files,
  G_ls,
  nT,
  fnrow,
  fncol,
  bnrow,
  bncol,
  path_out,
  delta = 1,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

ff_files

The list of file paths returned by FF_bigdata_R().

G_ls

The state transition file path(s) given to FF_bigdata_R(): one path, or one per time step.

nT, fnrow, fncol, bnrow, bncol

As given to FF_bigdata_R().

path_out

Directory where the output CSV files are written.

delta

Discount factor. Not implemented: values other than 1 give a warning and are ignored. Defaults to 1.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, reports progress.

Value

A list of file paths with one file per time step:

st_ls

Smoothed state means; the \(p \times C_b\) blocks are bound by column in traversal order, as in the filter's mt files.

St_ls

Smoothed left covariances, \(p \times p\) blocks bound by column.

See also

FF_bigdata_R(), FFBS_predict_bigdata_R(), BS()

Examples

set.seed(1)
dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "bs_big")
dir.create(dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
csv <- function(x, name) {
  path <- file.path(dir, name)
  utils::write.csv(x, path, row.names = FALSE)
  path
}
# 5 runs x 4 sites over 3 times, in two blocks of 2 sites (AR(1) designs)
Y <- lapply(1:3, function(t) matrix(rnorm(20, t), 5, 4))
F <- c(list(matrix(1, 5, 4)), Y[1:2])
ff <- FF_bigdata_R(Y_ls = mapply(csv, Y, paste0("Y", 1:3, ".csv")),
  F_ls = mapply(csv, F, paste0("F", 1:3, ".csv")),
  G_ls = csv(diag(2), "G.csv"), W_ls = csv(diag(2), "W.csv"),
  V_ls = csv(diag(5), "V.csv"), m0 = matrix(0, 2, 2), M0 = diag(2),
  n0 = 4, D0 = diag(2), nT = 3, fnrow = 5, fncol = 4, bnrow = 5,
  bncol = 2, path_out = dir)
bs <- BS_bigdata_R(ff, file.path(dir, "G.csv"), nT = 3, fnrow = 5,
  fncol = 4, bnrow = 5, bncol = 2, path_out = dir)
utils::read.csv(bs$st_ls[1])  # smoothed means at time 1, both blocks
#>          V1        V2         V3        V4
#> 1 0.2511867 0.5446719 0.09863948 0.6876736
#> 2 0.8224550 0.5645969 0.95554192 0.7175611
unlink(dir, recursive = TRUE)
